_comment: Repairable colony modules. Stages are worked in order; each consumes its own materials.

modules.name: Oxygen Recycler
modules.description: Scrubs and re-oxygenates station air. Someone shut it down from the inside.
modules.benefitText: Clean air. You can work longer before you flag.

stages.name: Clear the choked intake
stages.description: The intake is packed solid with dried spore matting.

stages.name: Reseat the filter stack
stages.description: The stack needs new glass and something living to prime it.

modules.name: Communications Array
modules.description: The long-range dish. Its logs end mid-sentence, and nothing was ever transmitted.
modules.benefitText: The survey overlay marks landmarks you have not walked yet.

stages.name: Re-anchor the mast
stages.description: Three of the four guy anchors were cut, not broken.

stages.name: Rebuild the signal board
stages.description: The board was removed carefully and never put back.

stages.name: Align and power up
stages.description: One clean alignment pass and the dish will talk again.

modules.name: Hydroponics Controller
modules.description: Runs the terrace irrigation. Its last programme was written to run for a hundred years.
modules.benefitText: The terrace holds moisture. Watered soil stays wet through the next day.

stages.name: Flush the feed lines
stages.description: Mineral scale, a season of it.

stages.name: Replace the control head
stages.description: The head was unbolted and set down neatly beside the housing.
